data.name: Skytree
data.description: Skytree is a Dutch direct air capture technology company founded in 2014 in Amsterdam, with offices in Toronto and Nashville. It builds modular, solid-sorbent DAC machines (Cumulus and Stratus lines) for greenhouse/industrial CO₂ supply and large-scale permanent removal, and is the DAC technology partner on the Texas DAC park being developed with EDF Renewables and Return Carbon targeting 500,000 tonnes/year.
